messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: SEV-2 page fired to SRE Oncall (ben-oncall) — high TLS handshake failures from edge us-west-2 to customer-facing endpoints (cert mismatch / handshake failure rate spike). Incident link: https://redwood-internal/incidents/2623456789
ben-oncall: acked. I'm on it. pulling metrics now.
ben-oncall: seeing 502/525 type errors in edge logs, TLS handshake failures ~27% across requests to api.redwood.ai in us-west-2.
cassie_net: jumping in — can you paste an example trace id? I want to check LB target health and SNI.
ben-oncall: trace id 0a3f9c; curl from our health-check box: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health` -> TLS alert, handshake failure, no cert presented.
ben-oncall: run: `openssl s_client -connect api-redwood-edge-usw2:443 -servername api.redwood.ai` -> output: `no peer certificate available` then `handshake failure`.
dave_platform: adding logs from ingress controller: `ALB backend connection failed: TLS handshake error: remote error: handshake failure (ssl)`. Also see `target group: tg-prod-api-usw2` reports 60% unhealthy.
eve-support: customer impact: several customers reporting degraded completions, increased latency and 5xxs. Support ticket volume +30% in last 10m.
ben-oncall: digging into ALB target health: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:tg:prod-api-usw2` -> majority of targets Unhealthy: cause: health check tls handshake timeout.
cassie_net: checking certificate rollout history — we rotated certs earlier today with canary. Route53 > weighted routing to new cert variant? Possibly new cert without SAN for api.redwood.ai.
frank-mgr: who approved cert rollout? Any config change auths? This is customer-facing.
dave_platform: rollout was automated via deploy pipeline at 08:12UTC. I have the pipeline ID: pipeline/1189. It pushed updated nginx/ingress with new cert mount.
ben-oncall: hypothesis: new cert missing SAN or wrong key format causing ALB->backend mTLS failure; LB health checks now fail, LB marks targets unhealthy, edge returns handshake failures.
cassie_net: can we rollback to previous cert quickly? If certs are in Secrets Manager we can point ingress to old secret and restart pods.
dave_platform: starting rollback job now: `kubectl set image deployment/ingress-proxy -n prod ingress-proxy=ingress-proxy:v2026.02.1` then patch secret to previous: `kubectl create secret tls redwood-cert --cert=old.crt --key=old.key -o yaml --dry-run=client | kubectl apply -f -`
ben-oncall: paging pagerduty for network-team as a second contact. pagerduty: escalated.
pagerduty: Incident 89012 escalated to on-call: network-team. Acknowledgement required.
cassie_net: acknowledged. applying secret rollback now.
dave_platform: rollback applied, restarting pods in prod us-west-2. Rolling restart of ingress-proxy triggered.
ben-oncall: monitoring health checks...
ben-oncall: ALB target health back to healthy 3/3 for most targets. TLS handshake failures drop to <1% in 60s.
eve-support: confirming reduction in customer error reports; new tickets dropping to baseline. Informing affected customers via status page.
frank-mgr: good. prepare timeline and RCA stub. Also plan a short postmortem.
cassie_net: root cause likely mispackaged cert (missing SAN) during today's automated rotation. Steps: certificate build pipeline missing test that validates SANs against hostnames in ingress config.
dave_platform: adding mitigation: add preflight check to pipeline: `openssl x509 -noout -text -in cert.pem | grep -A1 'Subject Alternative Name'` + fail deploy if mismatch. Also add canary weight ramp slower (5% -> 50% over 15m).
ben-oncall: oncall handoff in 2h — I'll add notes to incident doc and escalate to next shift.
ben-oncall: timeline for incident: 08:12 deploy cert rotate, 08:19 first TLS errors observed, 08:21 pager fired, 08:23 rollback started, 08:25 ingress restart, 08:27 errors drop below threshold, 08:35 incident declared mitigated.
eve-support: impact summary for customers: ~27% handshake failures for 13 minutes, affecting ~4% of requests overall during window. No data loss.
frank-mgr: thanks. please create follow-up ticket to add pipeline gate and schedule blameless postmortem tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident 2623456789 marked as mitigated. Severity: SEV-2. Owners: ben-oncall, cassie_net, dave_platform. Playbook: https://redwood-internal/incidents/playbooks/tls-rollout-checks
ben-oncall: handing off to next oncall @ben-oncall->@backup-oncall in 1h. leaving notes in the doc.
cassie_net: I'll run a cert inventory sweep across regions to ensure no further mis-rotations.
dave_platform: deploying pipeline change to staging now (`pipeline/1192`). Will cut release after tests.
eve-support: posting public status update: "We experienced a partial outage of TLS handshakes affecting API in us-west-2. Traffic rerouted and service restored within 20 minutes. We're investigating root cause."
